subject: Food Science
title: Sugar Alternatives
description: A micro-lesson that makes Sugar Alternatives usable.

hook.text: Aspartame is 200 times sweeter than sugar. You need a tiny pinch to match a whole spoonful.

buildup.text: High-intensity sweeteners—aspartame, sucralose, stevia—trigger sweet receptors without providing calories.

discovery.text: Sugar alcohols like erythritol and xylitol provide bulk and sweetness with fewer calories and no blood sugar spike.

twist.text: Some studies suggest artificial sweeteners may alter gut bacteria and even increase cravings for real sugar.

climax.text: No perfect substitute exists. Each alternative trades off taste, cost, baking properties, or health uncertainty.

punchline.text: 200 times sweeter, zero calories. But sweetness without sugar has trade-offs.

quiz.question: How much sweeter than sugar is aspartame?
